dashed_rectangles.note: count may be off by one because of overprinted labels at (1039,962) and (902,1081)

infers.edge_category_mapping: colour decides category: teal=eaves (including internal flat-to-flat lines and the hip section bottom where it meets Flat 151), orange=parapet wall (all outer flat-roof walls and 151 sides), yellow=rakes, purple=hips, light green=ridge, dashed blue=wall flashing, dashed brown=step flashing. Colours judged from a skewed photo.
infers.diagram_scale: about 6.1 px per foot in the 1500x2000 display; local scale varies about 5 percent across the page (perspective)
infers.page_tilt: horizontals tilt about 1.8 degrees; I rotated by that in plan.geojson
